benefits.title: Technical Audits
benefits.description: Review architecture, performance, security, SEO foundations, integrations, and delivery risks before they become expensive.

benefits.title: MVP & Product Roadmaps
benefits.description: Turn rough ideas into prioritized scopes, release plans, KPIs, and realistic build phases.

benefits.title: Architecture Reviews
benefits.description: Validate frontend, backend, data, integration, and cloud choices against your product goals.

benefits.title: Workflow Mapping
benefits.description: Map real business processes and identify where CMS, SaaS tools, internal software, or automation can help.

benefits.title: Cloud & QA Planning
benefits.description: Define delivery pipelines, test strategy, observability, release checks, and operational readiness.

benefits.title: Performance & SEO Roadmaps
benefits.description: Prioritize Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, analytics, and conversion improvements around business outcomes.

process.title: Discovery & Audit

process.title: Strategy & Scope
process.description: Define the MVP, architecture direction, KPIs, roadmap, and implementation priorities.

process.title: Technical Plan
process.description: Document system flows, integrations, cloud/QA requirements, automation opportunities, and delivery milestones.
